main_text.l: eum ueniret abbas Cassinensis, ait ipse Hildebran-dus: Frater nimium tardasti. Respondit abbas: Et tu Hildebrande nimium festinasti, qui nondum sepulto Domino tuo Papa, sedem Apostolicam contra Canones usurpasti. Hoc modo intbronizatus Hildebrandus, qualiter uixerit, qualiter a se Cardinales, qui testes uitae & doctrinae eius esse debuerant, remouerit: quam miserabiliter uexauerit, quantis haeresibus mundum corruperit, quanta per iuria, quam immensas proditiones confecrauerit, nix a multis describi poteft. Clamat tamen altius sanguis Christianorum eo authore & incentore, miserabiliter effusus. Haec Benno,

GRegorius septimus, natione Hetruscus, patria Senensis, secta uero Cluniacensis monachus, & Hildebrandus antea uocatus impostor, incantator ac praestigiator diabolicus, maudita (ut diZum est) tyrannide, papatum inuasit. Relicto hic olim coenobio professus Romam, Laurentio archipresbytero se insinuauit, a quo magicas artes ac necromantiam didicit. Quas artes & ipse Laurentius adhuc iuuenis, a Syluestro papa secunda eius nominis, Sathanico monstro, inter alios baufit. Erat quidem peculiaris necessitudo inter illum Laurentium, Theophylactum, Ioannem Gratia-

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Passage ends on a hyphenated half word "Gratia-", with the catchword "num," below. The text contains several evident printing irregularities, left as printed: "intbronizatus", "maudita", "(ut diZum est)" (the letter after "di" is a damaged form, rendered here as Z and marked for doubt), "baufit", "sanguis" versus "fangiis", and "Hetruscus" with a broken character. "Cardinales" and "describi" are read from partly damaged type. The marked form "diZum" and "fangiis" should be checked against the scan. The heading number "98." is printed in the head line, as in the scan.
